legend: A group of students is starting a competitive programming club, and they expect that N$$$N$$$ people will join, one by one. When each person joins, they must bring between 1$$$1$$$ and K$$$K$$$ balloons.

The founders want to make sure things stay fair and decided to impose the following fairness rule: after each person joins, it must be possible to evenly redistribute all balloons collected so far among the current members. In other words, after each step, the total number of balloons so far must be divisible by the current number of people.

Being competitive programmers, they realized that this makes for a nice counting problem, and decided to challenge you. How many sequences of N$$$N$$$ balloon contributions (each contribution between 1$$$1$$$ and K$$$K$$$) satisfy the fairness rule at every step?
Two sequences are considered different if they differ at any position.
input: The input consists of two integers N$$$N$$$ (1≤N≤109$$$1 \le N \le 10^9$$$) and K$$$K$$$ (1≤K≤2000$$$1 \le K \le 2000$$$), indicating respectively the number of members and the maximum number of balloons each member can bring.
output: Output a single line with an integer indicating the number of balloon contribution sequences that satisfy the fairness rule. Because this number can be very large, output the remainder of dividing it by 998244353$$$998244353$$$.
note: The (5) sequences of balloon contributions respecting the fairness rule are: [ [1,1,1], [1,3,2], [2,2,2], [3,1,2], [3,3,3]. ]
Everyone must contribute with a single baloon so the only possible sequence is [1,1,1,1]$$$[1,1,1,1]$$$.

legend.ai: 一群学生正准备创办一个竞赛编程俱乐部，他们预计会有 N$$$N$$$ 个人陆续加入。每个人加入时，都必须带来至少 1$$$1$$$ 个、至多 K$$$K$$$ 个气球。
创始人希望确保一切公平，因此决定制定以下公平规则：每有一个人加入，都必须能够将目前收集到的所有气球平均分给当前所有成员。换句话说，每一步结束后，目前气球总数必须能被当前人数整除。
作为竞赛程序员，他们意识到这是一个很适合计数的问题，于是决定向你发起挑战。满足每一步公平规则的 N$$$N$$$ 种气球贡献序列有多少种？每个人带来的气球数在 1$$$1$$$ 到 K$$$K$$$ 之间。
如果两个序列在任意位置上的元素不同，则认为它们不同。

input.ai: 输入包含两个整数 N$$$N$$$ (1≤N≤109$$$1 \le N \le 10^9$$$) 和 K$$$K$$$ (1≤K≤2000$$$1 \le K \le 2000$$$)，分别表示成员数量和每位成员最多能带来的气球数量。

output.ai: 输出一行一个整数，表示满足公平规则的气球贡献序列数量。由于这个数可能非常大，请输出其除以 998244353$$$998244353$$$ 的余数。

note.ai: 每个人都必须贡献一个气球，因此唯一可能的序列是 [1,1,1,1]$$$[1,1,1,1]$$$。
